text: Based on the Earth-observation evidence, **this property did not lose 67.7 ha of tree cover after the EUDR cut-off date (December 31, 2020)**. The 67.7 ha loss event occurred in **2020 itself**, which falls *before* the baseline date. After 2020, only minor losses (0.4 ha in 2021) were detected, but these were in patches smaller than the 0.5 ha minimum event threshold and thus do not count as significant loss events. Both the Hansen and JRC datasets confirm no substantial tree-cover loss after the baseline.
